archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: Health Management Information Service System
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation:
A Health Management Information Service System is an integrated digital platform designed to collect, store, manage, and transmit comprehensive healthcare data across clinical and administrative networks.
Its core purpose is to streamline operational workflows and provide real-time data insights that enable healthcare providers to make informed decisions and improve overall patient care quality.
A regional hospital network uses this system to instantly share patient electronic health records, track bed availability, and automatically report disease outbreaks to public health authorities.
